chunk:
deviations: |
  No dominant cross-vendor standard for construction budget-worksheet records. Field naming derived from:
    - ComputerEase budget worksheet entity (target system)
    - Construction industry job-cost-accounting norms (cost types, target price, GA%)

description: |
  Canonical budget-worksheet entity for construction / specialty-contractor integrations.
  Maps from: CRM (Salesforce Quote totals + line items).
  Maps to:   construction ERP (ComputerEase budget worksheet attached to a Job).
  Common synonyms: Budget Worksheet (ComputerEase), Job Budget (generic), Cost Plan (Procore), Cost Sheet (estimating).

  Peerless-specific: ComputerEase budget worksheet sits under a Job (canonical-job.yaml) and contains
  line items by cost type (materials, labor, subcontract, overhead GA). Sales commission and target
  price are part of the worksheet payload. Currently entered manually by Ashley (~1.5h per job) — UC2
  automates this on quote 'Save as Final'.

required:
  - worksheetId
  - jobId
  - costLines
  - targetPrice
  - timestamps

properties:
  worksheetId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical budget worksheet identifier
    example: "BW-2026-000565"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      erpWorksheetId:    { type: string, description: "ComputerEase worksheet ID (attached to a Job)" }
      salesforceQuoteId: { type: string, description: "Originating Salesforce Quote 18-char ID" }

  jobId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-job (the parent job)

  quoteId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-quote (the originating quote)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, APPROVED, LOCKED, CLOSED]

  costLines:
    type: array
    description: Cost lines by cost type (ComputerEase API access entitles Cost Types object)
    items:
      type: object
      required: [costType, budgetAmount]
      properties:
        costType:       { type: string, description: "ComputerEase cost type code (e.g. MAT, LAB, SUB, OH)" }
        costTypeName:   { type: string, description: "Human-readable cost type name" }
        budgetAmount:   { type: number, description: "Budgeted dollars for this cost type" }
        actualAmount:   { type: number, description: "Actuals to date (closed-loop reporting — UC7-potential)" }
        committedAmount: { type: number, description: "Committed subcontracts + POs against this cost type" }

  subcontracts:
    type: array
    description: Subcontract line items (ComputerEase Subcontracts object — UC6-potential)
    items:
      ty

stubNote: |
  Created from peerless engagement 2026-05-22 by Rex. UC2 confirmed flow: Salesforce Quote → CE Budget
  Worksheet attached to a Job. UC6-potential covers subcontract/commission worksheet payload if UC2
  scope is 'header only'. UC7-potential (closed-loop) writes actualAmount + committedAmount back to
  Salesforce for the AgentForce margin watcher in Phase 3. Fields to finalize during Analyst PRD:
  ComputerEase cost-type codes (Peerless-specific list), GA rate per company code, commission tier
  schedule per sales rep, marginThreshold default + per-job override mechanism.
